output.summary: KEP-3838 proposes relaxing Pod node selector and node affinity immutability so that gated pods (blocked on a scheduling readiness gate) can have their scheduling directives further constrained. Status is implementable, stage stable.
output.rationale: External resource controllers need to influence where a pod lands while leaving pod-to-node binding to kube-scheduler. Node affinity and selector were immutable, so the KEP allows changes only for pods still blocked by a scheduling gate and only when the change further constrains placement. Reviewers narrowed the rule to appending to existing matchExpressions/fieldExpressions and to new preferred terms, and required nodeName/schedulingGates validation to be unconditional.

alternatives.option: Allow mutating node affinity/selector of pods unconditionally
alternatives.why_not: Listed as a non-goal; the KEP restricts the change to pods blocked on a scheduling readiness gate.
Non-goal: "It is not clear how this can be done without potentially violating a policy check that was previously done at pod CREATE."

alternatives.option: Restrict adding tolerations on scheduling gates
alternatives.why_not: Non-goal: tolerations are already allowed unconditionally, so restricting them to gated pods would not be backward compatible.

alternatives.option: Introduce a separate feature gate for this change
alternatives.why_not: A reviewer proposed depending on the same flag: "we can depend on the same flag, we don't need to introduce a new one."

evidence.quote: make the pod scheduling directives node selector and node affinity mutable as long as the pod is gated and the update to node selector/affinity further limits the existing constraints
We will only allow additions, no changes to existing terms will be allowed. This is easier to reason about.
looks like BindingREST#setPodHostAndAnnotations and ValidatePodCreate both need to be updated to do their validation unconditionally
this feature is actually under the umbrella of #3521, it makes more sense to just fold this into #3521.
